name: wow-forever
description: Offline WoW Forever guide for Hermes, for any race, class and faction (English UI, Spanish optional): trainers, spells and class quests, leveling zones, professions with a leveling plan, dungeons with bosses and loot, a curated Horde Hunter guide checked against the data, Legacy, and a local market fed by Auctionator, TSM accounting and the WoWForeverBridge daily diary, with item thumbnails tied to each item id. Includes a skill that answers from the same data with a read-only script. No network. Reads only Auctionator.lua, TradeSkillMaster.lua, WoWForeverBridge.lua and WoWForeverFarm.lua (farming sessions from the companion WoWForeverFarm addon) inside the folder the user grants; Pawn.lua is read only after an explicit, revocable opt-in. Farming plans aim at realized gold per session hour, calibrated from your own measured sessions, and the skill can coach from them.
